annotations.title: Sync the preview to the flow's files

description: Reconcile a (running or cold) preview sandbox to the flow's current files and run the green-build gate (tsc + vite build). Returns the gate result — the fastest way to know your code actually compiles. The engine forces parts of package.json on every sync: the dev/build/typecheck scripts, and the vendored command-frame + mock packages to their bundled tarballs. Baseline and build dependencies are re-added only when you declared them nowhere, so your own additions and pins survive. Shares one rate bucket with start_preview — sync once per change-set, not per file.
name: flow_sync_preview
